open_obligations.what_is_open: It remains open whether the orbit-aware saddle column-generation handle can be turned, for every arbitrary DTE conflict graph, into a randomized polynomial-time algorithm returning both a polynomial-support finite-prior lower certificate and a polynomial-support realizable design--estimator upper action whose certified risks differ by a universal constant factor.
open_obligations.obstruction: The frozen handle specifies candidate column-generation operations but supplies neither a polynomial-time separation oracle for maximal compatible exposure sets nor a proof that polynomially many posterior-collision columns suffice.  It also gives no general-graph purification theorem converting a relaxed upper action into an implementable binary randomization and measurable estimator.  The available published graph-functional bounds can have a nonconstant gap, while the exact block-clique saddle relies on symmetry absent from a general graph.  Finally, the frozen core contains no declared Unique Games or randomized-complexity assumption and no two-sided value-preserving reduction with both a low-risk YES design and a high-risk NO certificate against every assignment law and estimator; one-sided independent-set hardness or hardness for a proxy would not close this obligation.
open_obligations.attempted: The finite-prior route was pushed through posterior-cell enumeration: any explicitly supplied prior gives an auditable Bayes lower certificate, and the balanced-biclique construction yields a four-atom certificate.  The realizable-upper route was checked against the published spectral procedure, but its \((\lambda(G)+1)/n\) certificate does not stay within a universal factor of the available lower functionals on arbitrary graphs.  The block-clique purification argument was also examined, but its three-mode decomposition and orbit symmetrization do not extend to a graph without that symmetry.  A hardness route based only on maximal independent set was rejected because it does not establish the required two-sided preservation of the unrestricted minimax value.
